Tests XHR network resource type and size for asynchronous requests when "blob" is specified as the response type.

http://127.0.0.1:8000/inspector-protocol/network/resources/get-response-body-valid-text.php
xhr.responseType: blob
xhr.response instanceof Blob: true
xhr.response.size: 13
resource.type: xhr
resource.size: 13
base64Encoded: false
resource.content after requesting content: Hello, World!
